mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.chain_id, n.name, n.layer, n.description, n.parent_id, n.sort_order, n.is_deleted, n.deleted_at, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM chain_node n WHERE n.chain_id = #{chainId} AND n.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY n.sort_order ASC, n.id ASC

SELECT id, chain_id, name, layer, description, parent_id, sort_order, is_deleted, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM chain_node WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT e.id AS enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, e.unified_code AS unified_code, e.legal_representative AS legal_representative, e.registered_address AS registered_address, e.region_id AS region_id, e.is_local AS is_local, e.employee_scale AS employee_scale, COALESCE(ps.patent_count, 0) AS patent_count, COALESCE(ps.high_value_count, 0) AS high_value_count FROM enterprise_node en INNER JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = en.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.employee_scale IN ('大型', '中大型', '中型') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.applicant_enterprise_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patent_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.maintenance_years >= 10 THEN p.id END) AS high_value_count FROM patent_node pn INNER JOIN patent p ON pn.patent_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE pn.node_id = #{nodeId} GROUP BY p.applicant_enterprise_id ) ps ON ps.applicant_enterprise_id = e.id WHERE en.node_id = #{nodeId} ORDER BY patent_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
